name: Voxel Material Packing
definition: A data layout for storing material properties and color within a single 32-bit voxel value, allowing up to 256 distinct materials to be managed by a MaterialManager.
summary: Voxel Material Packing encodes a voxel's material ID and RGB color into a single 32-bit integer, differing from other layouts by strictly binding these properties to the value itself for efficient single-fetch access.
